People in the 1000 Genomes Project

Source: R/data.R
samples_1kg.Rd

The 2,504 unrelated people from 26 populations whose genomes were sequenced by the 1000 Genomes Project. These are the people included in every snpscape object.

Usage

samples_1kg

Format

A tibble with 2,504 rows and 6 columns:

sample_id

Sample identifier, e.g. "HG00096".

pop

Three-letter population code, e.g. "GBR".

super_pop

Super-population code, e.g. "EUR".

sex

"female" or "male".

pop_name

Full population name.

super_pop_name

Full super-population name.

Source

1000 Genomes Project, International Genome Sample Resource: https://www.internationalgenome.org. Built by data-raw/samples_1kg.R.

Details

The 26 populations are grouped into five continental super-populations: African (AFR), Admixed American (AMR), East Asian (EAS), European (EUR) and South Asian (SAS). "Admixed American" populations have recent ancestry from several continents (Indigenous American, European and African). Some populations were sampled outside their region of ancestral origin, for example Gujarati Indians in Houston (GIH) and Sri Lankan Tamils in the UK (STU).

Examples

samples_1kg
#> # A tibble: 2,504 × 6
#>    sample_id pop   super_pop sex    pop_name                      super_pop_name
#>    <chr>     <chr> <chr>     <chr>  <chr>                         <chr>         
#>  1 HG01879   ACB   AFR       male   African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  2 HG01880   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  3 HG01882   ACB   AFR       male   African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  4 HG01883   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  5 HG01885   ACB   AFR       male   African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  6 HG01886   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  7 HG01889   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  8 HG01890   ACB   AFR       male   African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#>  9 HG01894   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#> 10 HG01896   ACB   AFR       female African Caribbean in Barbados African       
#> # ℹ 2,494 more rows
table(samples_1kg$super_pop)
#> 
#> AFR AMR EAS EUR SAS 
#> 661 347 504 503 489
